text:
Four of six done. NormTolerance at 10ea1b1; HsmmResult.Tolerance and PlacementResolution.Tolerance at e4bbf5b.

embed-grakern's Epsilon needed NOTHING -- it already names its phenomenon ('floating-point noise of the normalized kernel, e.g. 2.2e-16'). It was the model I cited when filing this bead and it turns out to have been compliant all along, which is worth recording so nobody edits it to match a template.

REMAINING: signature.scala:208 and :332, both Tolerance = 1e-9. Left alone deliberately -- m1's blend work is adjacent and comment-only churn in that file is not worth the collision risk while it is mid-change. Pick them up after m1 lands.

WHAT THE TWO DOCUMENTED ONES TURNED OUT TO BE, because it changes what the remaining work is: HsmmResult.Tolerance sits four to five orders ABOVE its phenomenon (float64 row accumulation, n*2.22e-16) and the margin is not derived -- it is a round number. PlacementResolution.Tolerance is INHERITED from align outright and has never been computed against its own inputs, which are three float64 additions with error near 1e-16, seven orders below.

So the honest finding is that most of these constants are inherited or round rather than derived, and the value of this bead is admitting that in the code rather than tightening anything. Do not tighten on the strength of these comments; they record what is unknown, not a licence to narrow.

Reservations released.
